description: 12h memory-stability soak - Ruby valkey-glide-ruby, one cell. Select the GLIDE gem with bench-aws.sh --ruby-client-version. Memory signal: process-group RSS (all forked workers) sampled every 5s into <label>.system.ndjson. The Ruby engine has no per-interval throughput/latency reporting, so those are one 12h aggregate. 8 connections = 8 worker processes, leaving CPU headroom for the colocated server on an 8-vCPU m5.2xlarge. Launch with --runtime-cap 780 so the cap never fires before the upload.
